title: A Muse In’ Paradise Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: The brightly colored ‘Wash Ashore’ cottage is hard to miss, with a spectacular location close to Seaside Chapel, the playground, tennis courts and the family pool.
description_expanded: 520 FOREST STREETCharming Seaside Cottage Retreat | “A Muse In’ Paradise” | Sleeps 8Recently updated, “A Muse In’ Paradise” has been thoughtfully refreshed with new furnishings and original artwork throughout, creating a bright and welcoming coastal retreat. Ideally located in the heart of Seaside, Florida, the cottage sits just moments from the Seaside Chapel, playground, tennis courts, and family pool, with the beach only a short walk away. Tucked along the eastern side near Seaside Avenue, the home offers a classic floor plan, timeless design elements, and undeniable charm. Multiple private outdoor spaces, including screened porches, invite guests to relax and take in the surrounding tropical landscape.Main Living Spaces | Comfortable Gathering & Thoughtful DesignThe main gathering room is spacious and inviting, offering ample seating, a smart TV, a sound system, and an abundance of natural light streaming through the windows. This comfortable living area flows seamlessly into the galley-style kitchen, which features generous counter space and ample cabinetry for storage. A pass-through window connects the kitchen to the dining area, where a table for six creates the perfect setting for shared meals.Just beyond, an additional back den and game area provides a second living space for guests to unwind. This sun-filled room includes another television and an additional table, making it ideal for games, reading, or quiet relaxation. During cooler months, guests can enjoy the warmth and ambiance of the Vermont cast iron gas stove, adding to the cozy charm of the home. A full bathroom on the first floor also includes a washer and dryer for added convenience.Second Floor Bedrooms | Relaxed Coastal ComfortAll three bedrooms are located on the second floor, offering a peaceful retreat after a day at the beach. The cheerful primary suite features a king-sized bed, television, private ensuite bath, and its own screened porch with plush seating overlooking Forest Street—an ideal spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation.One guest bedroom includes bunk beds along with a twin bed and an additional trundle, providing flexible sleeping arrangements for families or groups. The second guest bedroom offers a comfortable queen-sized bed. These two guest rooms share access to a screened porch overlooking a wooded backdrop, creating a quiet and restful setting. Both rooms share a full bathroom located in the hallway and may also utilize the first-floor full bath.Outdoor Living & Location | Classic Seaside ExperienceSurrounded by lush greenery and thoughtfully designed outdoor spaces, “A Muse In’ Paradise” embraces the relaxed coastal lifestyle that makes Seaside, Florida so special. With multiple screened porches and inviting areas to gather, guests can enjoy both privacy and connection throughout their stay.With its prime location, charming design, and updated interiors, this cottage offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and classic Seaside appeal—ideal for families and groups looking to experience 30A at its best.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum; Fall 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURESFeatures 1732 square feetSeaside private residential beach at East Ruskin PavilionSeaside is the largest residential private beach on 30A528 yards or 6-minute walk to beach access65' new smart TVFull-sized washer & dryer on first floorClose to tennis courts, fitness center, adult pool, and family poolFront screened porch with swingPorches off of all three bedroomsOutside showerPeacock Alley premium linens – fresh, luxurious towels, sheets, etc throughout the cottageAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts, 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service and starter amenities are provided during your stayOnly 1 parking pass per one-bedroom cottage and 2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car.Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit. No pets STR23-002294
